announce-assign: Everyone sees who the others are. Your own card is hidden.
announce-final: Final guess. Everyone not yet right has one guess.
announce-timeout: The turn ran out with no question.
announce-vote: A question is up. Vote yes, no or maybe.
announce-your-turn: Your turn to ask a question.
ask-label: Ask the table a yes-or-no question about who you are
final-sent: Guess sent. Waiting for the others.
final-solved: You already got it. Waiting for the others.
final-watching: The table is making its final guesses.
guess-early-hint: A wrong guess costs 100 points and ends your questions.
guess-early-label: Think you know? Guess who you are
guess-final-hint: One guess. Right is worth 200 points.
solved-note: You got it. You still vote on the others.
status-ask-self: Your turn: ask a yes-or-no question.
status-assign: Study the board. You are the one marked with a question mark.
status-assign-spectator: Everyone is being dealt an identity.
status-vote-self: The table is voting on your question.
stopped-note: You are out of questions. You still vote, and you have a final guess.
vote-asker: The table is voting on your question.
vote-group: Your vote. Keys Y, N and M also vote.
vote-open: Vote on the question. Nobody sees who voted what.
